scripts.build:android: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist/downloads/TalkTics.apk',{force:true});" && cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run build:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk','public/downloads/TalkTics.apk'); if(fs.existsSync('dist/downloads')) fs.copyFileSync('android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk','dist/downloads/TalkTics.apk');"
scripts.apk:release: npm run build:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk','public/downloads/TalkTics.apk'); if(fs.existsSync('dist/downloads')) fs.copyFileSync('android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk','dist/downloads/TalkTics.apk');"
